symptom: Over `--mcp` on Studio Pro 11.16, every DROP of a standalone document (constant, enumeration, microflow, nanoflow, page, workflow, business-event service) demanded `--mcp-concord`, though 11.16 ships `ped_delete_document`. Separately, a PED tool whose handler throws answers `Error executing tool handler: …` with `isError:false`, which any caller trusting the flag reads as success
cause: `concordDeleteDocument` was the only DROP path, written when PED had no delete tool. `Client.CallTool` passed `isError` through verbatim, and only the create/update callers (`pedOpError`'s `SUCCESS` prefix) noticed failures reported in the text
file: `mdl/backend/mcp/delete.go` (new `deleteDocument`: native when `HasTool("ped_delete_document")`, else an error naming 11.16+; Concord support removed in the same change), `client.go` (`HasTool`, `handlerFailed` sets `IsError`), the seven `Delete*` call sites, `capabilities.yaml`/`.go` report text
insight: **Probe tool presence, never the version**: `serverInfo.version` was 1.0.0 on 11.12.0 and 11.16.0 reports itself, but the delete tool is the fact that matters. **On 11.16.0 the native delete fails for every caller outside Studio Pro's own agent session** (`Session 'mcp-server' not found`, measured from a devcontainer through four clientInfo names), so the success reply has never been seen. The code therefore settles an unrecognised reply by `ped_find_document` instead of guessing the text. **Revert check**: stubbing `handlerFailed` fails `TestCallTool_HandlerErrorIsAnError`, and removing the `HasTool` gate fails `TestDeleteDocument_NoNativeToolNeeds1116`. Live runs are in mx-test-projects/runs/native-delete/
